ImageDescription.value: City of London skyline from Bankside, Southwark, on the south bank of the Thames, April 2020. Prominent tall buildings include Tower 42; 22 Bishopsgate; 122 Leadenhall Street; The Scalpel; and 20 Fenchurch Street. Vintners' Place can be seen on the north bank of the Thames; and the Millennium Bridge crosses the picture in the foreground.

ImageDescription.value: City skyline from the South Bank of the Thames
London skyline with the Blackfriars bridge

A cruise on the Thames River has been one of my favorite activities in London.  St. Paul's Cathedral is on the left.   The National Westminster Tower is on the right.  It was London's tallest building from 1980 to 1990, at 600 ft (183 m).  Part of Blackfriars Bridge is visible.

Artist.value: Roger W from Sarasota, Florida, U.S.A.

83158039.title: File:View of the City of London skyline.jpg

ImageDescription.value: The City of London skyline, seen from the south bank of the River Thames. From left to right: Custom House (20 Lower Thames Street), Landmark Place, Cheval Three Quays, and Tower Place East. Behind those buildings, high rises including 20 Fenchurch Street, Plantation Place, 20 Gracechurch Street, 22 Bishopgate, 122 Leadenhall Street, Willis Building, The Scalpel (under construction), 30 St Mary Axe, and 100 Bishopgate (under construction) are visible.
